name: cpcb-aqi-exceedance
split_description: temporal split on the prediction instant (day D, 23:59 IST): train 2019-2022, eval 2023, holdout 2024; scored rows are complete (n_hours >= 18) cpcb_caaqm PM2.5 station-days with a labelable D+1 (row present, n_hours >= 18; unlabelable rows excluded and counted); the 2025-04..09 partial tail (47,566 station-days) is excluded and counted, the 2025-01..03 and 2025-10..12 hole months are asserted empty; label = D+1 24-hr mean > 90 ug/m3 (CPCB National AQI Poor-band lower breakpoint)
